metas.name: Mean Girls
metas.description: Captures the same iconic teen comedy energy and sharp wit as Clueless and 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: The Mummy
metas.description: A perfect blend of adventure, comedy, and fantasy that aligns with your love for Dungeons & Dragons and Jumanji.

metas.name: Legally Blonde
metas.description: An uplifting, lighthearted comedy featuring a strong female lead, mirroring the charm found in Clueless.

metas.name: Easy A
metas.description: A smart, modern teen comedy that pays homage to 80s classics, similar in tone to 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Kiss Kiss Bang Bang
metas.description: Written by the same director as The Nice Guys, this offers a similar fast-paced, witty buddy-cop dynamic.

metas.name: Deadpool
metas.description: Matches the irreverent, self-aware humor and high-octane action seen in Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: The Princess Bride
metas.description: A comfort-movie staple that blends fantasy, romance, and comedy in the same vein as Practical Magic and D&D.

metas.name: Palm Springs
metas.description: A high-concept sci-fi rom-com that is both hilarious and surprisingly deep, perfect for fans of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Enchanted
metas.description: A delightful subversion of fantasy tropes with a lighthearted, feel-good atmosphere similar to Practical Magic.

metas.name: Knives Out
metas.description: A fun, stylized mystery with a great ensemble cast, echoing the cleverness of The Nice Guys.

metas.name: School of Rock
metas.description: The ultimate feel-good comedy that is easy to watch and incredibly uplifting.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: Captures the fun, energetic spirit of late-90s/early-2000s teen comedies like Clueless.

metas.name: Galaxy Quest
metas.description: A brilliant sci-fi comedy that balances adventure and humor just like Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Bullet Train
metas.description: A neon-soaked, high-energy action comedy that fans of Jumanji and Thor: Ragnarok will enjoy.

metas.name: Game Night
metas.description: A hilarious, fast-paced ensemble comedy that provides the same 'fun night in' vibe as The Nice Guys.

metas.name: Popstar: Never Stop Never Stopping
metas.description: A mockumentary with absurd humor that will appeal to fans of the outrageous comedy in Brüno.

metas.name: What We Do in the Shadows
metas.description: A clever fantasy-comedy mockumentary that fits your interest in both supernatural themes and dry wit.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A visually stunning, high-octane animated adventure that is consistently funny and heartwarming.

metas.name: Stardust
metas.description: A whimsical fantasy adventure with a romantic core, perfect for fans of Practical Magic and Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect
metas.description: A lighthearted, music-filled comedy that is highly rewatchable and focuses on comfort and fun.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A beautiful fantasy adventure with great world-building, matching the scale of Fantastic Beasts.

metas.name: Shazam!
metas.description: A superhero movie that prioritizes heart and humor over grit, similar to the tone of Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: Hot Fuzz
metas.description: An expert blend of action and comedy with a mystery element, perfect for fans of Ace Ventura and The Nice Guys.

metas.name: She's the Man
metas.description: A classic 'comfort' rom-com that shares the Shakespearean adaptation DNA with 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: The Lost City
metas.description: A fun jungle-based adventure comedy that directly appeals to fans of the modern Jumanji films.

metas.name: Spy
metas.description: A high-energy action comedy with fantastic performances that keeps the mood light and entertaining.

metas.name: Free Guy
metas.description: A lighthearted action-adventure set in a video game world, making it a natural fit for Jumanji fans.

metas.name: The Grand Budapest Hotel
metas.description: Visually whimsical and highly comedic, matching the stylized nature of Night Is Short, Walk On Girl.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description: A magical, feel-good romantic story with a unique visual style similar to your taste in animation and fantasy.

metas.name: Zombieland
metas.description: A fun, rules-based action-comedy that treats a horror premise with the same fun energy as Anaconda.

metas.name: Kingsman: The Secret Service
metas.description: High-octane, stylish action with a fun, slightly over-the-top tone that matches Thor: Ragnarok.

metas.name: The Fifth Element
metas.description: A vibrant, imaginative, and fun sci-fi adventure that doesn't take itself too seriously.

metas.name: Booksmart
metas.description: A fast-paced, witty teen comedy with great chemistry between leads, similar to Clueless.

metas.name: Midnight in Paris
metas.description: A whimsical fantasy-romance that explores a magical world within a real city, much like Practical Magic.

metas.name: Chef
metas.description: The ultimate low-stakes, feel-good comfort movie with great food and a heartwarming story.

metas.name: Coming to America
metas.description: A classic, lighthearted comedy with a fish-out-of-water story that is easy to watch and very funny.

metas.name: Big Trouble in Little China
metas.description: A cult classic that blends fantasy, martial arts, and comedy in a way that feels very similar to D&D: Honor Among Thieves.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: A fun, modern-feeling medieval adventure that shares the lighthearted spirit of 10 Things I Hate About You.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: Universally acclaimed for being the height of comfort cinema, it is funny, kind, and incredibly uplifting.
